notes: v1.1.104: Login reads the screen before acting - waits while Facebook is still loading / running security checks instead of typing the login again; no reload after a captcha (that sent accounts back to the Facebook home/login); waits for the captcha box to load and gives the captcha extension more time; 2FA code submitted right after typing; a slow 2FA screen is no longer taken for a rejected code; Trust this device page answered; m.facebook 'Wrong Credentials' retried on desktop instead of marked wrong password. Email login codes: a code that already arrived is now used even when the PC clock is wrong. App window stays responsive (UI priority). Website orders more human - every account scrolls its feed 15-40 s first (Browser m/web, Page, ADB), spaced windows/pages/accounts; ADB Review Page reads the question and uses thumb-scattered taps.
